# Seven Oak Prestige

> Seven Oak Prestige helps international entrepreneurs and non-residents register and run a UK limited company remotely. Services include UK company formation, registered office and director service addresses, nominee director service, VAT and EORI registration, Companies House identity verification support, UK accounting for non-residents, and guidance on opening UK business and fintech accounts. The site is available in English and French.

Seven Oak Prestige is a company formation and corporate services provider. It is not a bank, law firm or tax adviser; banking outcomes are decided by the banks and providers themselves.

## Core services

- [UK Company Formation for Non-Residents](https://www.sevenoakprestige.com/services/uk-company-formation-for-non-residents): Register a UK limited company remotely, with compliance support.
- [Buy a UK Shelf Company](https://www.sevenoakprestige.com/services/buy-shelf-company-uk): Ready-made UK companies for faster setup.
- [UK Nominee Director Service](https://www.sevenoakprestige.com/services/uk-nominee-director-service): Nominee director arrangements for UK companies.

## Compliance and registration

- [UK VAT Registration](https://www.sevenoakprestige.com/services/vat-registration-uk): Help registering for UK VAT.
- [UK EORI Registration](https://www.sevenoakprestige.com/services/eori-registration-uk): Help obtaining an EORI number for importing and exporting.
- [Companies House Identity Verification](https://www.sevenoakprestige.com/services/companies-house-identity-verification): Assistance with identity verification and Companies House personal codes.

## Address and office services

- [Registered Office Service](https://www.sevenoakprestige.com/services/registered-office-service): A UK registered office address for your company.
- [Director Service Address](https://www.sevenoakprestige.com/services/director-service-address): A UK service address for company directors.
- [Virtual Business Address](https://www.sevenoakprestige.com/services/virtual-business-address): A UK business address and mail handling.

## Banking, fintech and accounting

- [Fintech and Banking Guidance](https://www.sevenoakprestige.com/services/fintech-banking-guidance): Guidance on opening UK business and fintech accounts.
- [UK Accounting for Non-Residents](https://www.sevenoakprestige.com/services/uk-accounting-non-residents): Accounting and filing support for non-resident company owners.
